profile.name: Rigol DS1054Z数字示波器
profile.description: 这是一台台式数字示波器，通过USBTMC接口进行控制，用于采集和显示电信号波形，并可进行通道配置、触发设置、时基调整、采样与存储深度查询、波形数据读取以及屏幕截图获取，适合实验中的通用电信号观测与分析。
profile.description_en: This is a bench digital oscilloscope controlled over USBTMC, used to acquire and display electrical waveforms. It supports channel configuration, trigger setup, timebase adjustment, sampling and memory-depth queries, waveform data retrieval, and screenshot capture for general laboratory signal observation and analysis.
